knowledge.name: Fixed synthetic warranty snapshot
knowledge.detail: Six registered units with coverage type, dates, claim history and extension prices, fixed at 2026-03-02.

knowledge.name: Pending registration records
knowledge.detail: Two sold units with sale date, end customer, term and a 30-day registration window.

knowledge.name: Coverage and guardrail rules
knowledge.detail: Coverage-type terms, extension window and discount, and the no-filing, no-submission, no-sale boundaries.

intelligence_processing.name: Coverage overview
intelligence_processing.detail: Counts active, expiring, expired and awaiting-registration units and lists each with remaining days.

intelligence_processing.name: Claim pre-check
intelligence_processing.detail: Combines registration, active dates, coverage type and claim history into a covered, parts-only or not-eligible result.

intelligence_processing.name: Unit record assembly
intelligence_processing.detail: Returns one serial's dates, status, coverage terms and full claim history with the next step.

intelligence_processing.name: Serial validation
intelligence_processing.detail: Checks format, catalog presence and duplicate registration before a unit is registered.

intelligence_processing.name: Registration drafting
intelligence_processing.detail: Builds a Not Submitted registration with warranty start, term, end date and registration deadline.

intelligence_processing.name: Extension offer pricing
intelligence_processing.detail: Finds units ending within 90 days and applies the fixed discount to compute each offer and the total.

clients_user_interface.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio conversation
clients_user_interface.detail: Hosts the Draft agent with six skills and two synthetic knowledge files; publishing stays a separate approved step.

clients_user_interface.name: Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot access
clients_user_interface.detail: Gives dealer service and sales staff a conversational entry point once approved controls are configured.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs the single-file WarrantyRegistrationAgent locally with deterministic, synthetic-only operations.

management_reporting.name: Dealer coverage view
management_reporting.detail: Shows the dealer's units by coverage status with expiring and pending-registration counts.

management_reporting.name: Claim and registration drafts
management_reporting.detail: Presents pre-check results and registration drafts with explicit not-filed and not-submitted status.

management_reporting.name: Acceptance evidence
management_reporting.detail: Records six passing persona cases, package integrity and the unpublished Draft state.

tools.name: Portable WarrantyRegistrationAgent RAPP tool
tools.detail: Single-file Python BasicAgent with six deterministic, read-only operations over synthetic dealer data.

tools.name: Brainstem runtime
tools.detail: Local-first RAPP server that discovers the agent and exposes chat, health and tool-routing endpoints.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the six-skill package in Draft; publishing requires explicit authorized approval.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot
tools.detail: User surfaces for approved deployments; the package sends no messages or offers.

tools.name: Approved ERP warranty module
tools.detail: Production seam for dealer-scoped coverage and claim data; not connected in the demonstration.

tools.name: Approved registration service
tools.detail: Production seam for registration submission by the dealer; the agent only drafts.

supporting_features.name: Fixed synthetic evidence boundary
supporting_features.detail: Uses only the bundled fictional dealer snapshot and forbids browsing, live-system claims or invention.

supporting_features.name: Fixed snapshot date
supporting_features.detail: All day counts are computed against 2026-03-02 so answers are reproducible.

supporting_features.name: No external side effects
supporting_features.detail: Never files claims, submits registrations, activates warranties, sends offers or contacts customers.

supporting_features.name: Human warranty decisions
supporting_features.detail: Coverage decisions and exceptions stay with the manufacturer warranty desk.

supporting_features.name: Duplicate registration guard
supporting_features.detail: A registered serial returns a duplicate result instead of a new draft.

supporting_features.name: Deterministic routing and validation
supporting_features.detail: Six persona cases verify one operation each with exact evidence anchors.
